headline: Warning on Romania's rating: Euro could exceed 6 lei if the country falls into the "junk" category
summary: An economist warns a downgrade of Romania to non-investment grade could pressure the leu and interest rates, pushing the euro above 6 lei. Standard & Poor's is due to rule on Romania's sovereign rating on 2 October.
why: Sovereign credit ratings set borrowing costs for governments and influence capital flows into emerging-market bonds and currencies.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude

original_headline: Avertisment privind ratingul României: Euro ar putea trece de 6 lei dacă țara ajunge în categoria „junk”
